history.name: ArchitecturalHistory_Expert
history.content: Yes, the Marquette Building in Chicago is a designated landmark (1991) and historically significant. Designed by Holabird & Roche in the 1890s, it honors Jacques Marquette, who is also the namesake of the city of Marquette, Michigan. The successor firm is Holabird & Root. As of 2023, the firm name appears as "Holabird & Root." The first name in that firm's name is "Holabird."
